Connecting decision makers to a dynamic network of information, people and ideas, Bloomberg quickly and accurately delivers business and financial information, news and insight around the world. That’s been Bloomberg’s mission from day one, when we designed and built the Bloomberg Terminal – pioneering technology that transformed an industry where information was transmitted slowly and inefficiently. We’re a leader in the industry when it comes to applying artificial intelligence, machine learning and natural language processing to financial models and up-to-the-second market data. Learn about the Terminal and our other products. Today, our engineers and data analysts build, train, and use AI to process unstructured data at massive speeds and scale — so our customers are in the know faster. From real-time market and enterprise data to sophisticated analytics, powerful trading tools, secure biometric access, integrated communications platforms and more, we build solutions that are relied on by over 350,000 financial professionals around the globe to make critical business decisions.
"Bloomberg Tech" is our daily news program focused exclusively on technology, innovation and the future of business hosted by Ed Ludlow from San Francisco.
